en-US.name: YTKTV
en-US.releaseNotes:
🔑 Clearer password requests on macOS
- Installing with the one-line command now asks for your Mac password right in the terminal, saying why (to put the app in /Applications), instead of a macOS window that only said "a script started by i".
- Updating inside the app: when an update needs your password, YTKTV and YTKTV Desk now say so first, and macOS's password window names the app ("a script started by YTKTV"). This applies from the next update on, since the update is run by the version you have.
🔧 Also
- The project's automation (pull request checks, labels, release steps) now works under one account, with an approved pull request merging itself once every check passes.
- Release builds fail fast instead of waiting up to 40 minutes when a self-test of the built apps stalls.
Install
One line (checks the download, then installs; pick YTKTV, YTKTV Desk or both):
- macOS / Linux: curl -fsSL https://tonyd365.github.io/YTKTV/install.sh | bash
- Windows (PowerShell): irm https://tonyd365.github.io/YTKTV/install.ps1 | iex, or winget install TonyD365.YTKTV (YTKTV Desk is not in winget for now: it waited a long time without being accepted, so it is withdrawn there)
Already installed? YTKTV and YTKTV Desk update themselves (Settings → Updates).
Or download the installer from the files below:
───────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────
                               │YTKTV (the room)                                     │YTKTV Desk (the front desk)
───────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────
macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel)│YTKTV-…-macos-universal.pkg                          │YTKTV-Desk-…-macos-universal.pkg
───────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────
Windows                        │YTKTV-…-windows-x64-setup.exe (ARM:                  │YTKTV-Desk-…-windows-x64-setup.exe
                               │…-arm64-setup.exe)                                   │
───────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────
Linux                          │YTKTV-…-linux-x86_64.AppImage (ARM: aarch64)         │YTKTV-Desk-…-linux-x86_64.AppImage
───────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────
You don't need the other files: *-patch-*.zip are the small updates the apps download themselves, *-files.zip are used to make the next patches, and ytktv-installer-* is the program the one-line install runs. SHA256SUMS lists every file's checksum.
The installers are not code-signed yet, so macOS and Windows may warn before the first start. Help: README · Report a problem
